title: girardinia diversifolia
intro: Girardinia diversifolia, commonly known as Rau-ma or Long-leaf, is a plant species belonging to the Urticaceae family, native to the tropical regions of Asia. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing fever, treating digestive issues, and alleviating inflammation. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and anti-bacterial properties, which contribute to its traditional use in treating various health conditions. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
